learning_outcomes.text: Be able to optimally design value streams and map them in the production layout.
Be able to communicate complex relationships to the workforce and top management to increase the probability of implementation.
Be able to design and construct machine tools from a modern manufacturing perspective, considering accuracy requirements.
Consider the mechatronic aspects of machine tools, such as drives, measuring systems, kinematics, materials, control, and integration into existing manufacturing systems.
Be well prepared to increase both efficiency and innovation in production and successfully support the implementation of new technologies.

syllabus_topics: Structure, components and parts of machine tools
Materials and constructive design of the overall system
Static, dynamic and thermal behavior of machine tools
Integration into manufacturing and procurement of machine tools
Capture, analyze, and design an ideal value stream
Lean Logistics and Supply Chain Management
The synchronous production system according to Takeda
Logistical principles and material flow technology
Basic Change Management elements and their operational application
bibliography: Brecher, C., Weck, M.: Werkzeugmaschinen Fertigungssysteme, Band 1-5. Springer Verlag.
Das synchrone Produktionssystem, Hitoshi Takeda, Vahlen, Auflage: 7 ISBN-10: 3800646072
